title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-19
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD + AUD low-gen

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a rare early‑69 acoustic mini‑set and strong electric numbers, with crisp audio and high energy.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality with virtually no hiss, preserving an unusual ad‑hoc acoustic set that the Dead only played briefly in ’69. Reviewers highlight the spontaneous Mason’s tease before “All Around This World”, tight renditions of “Good Lovin’” and “Lovelight”, and even a humorous “Wake Up Little Susie” moment, all delivered with high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple reviewers (5) consistently rate the show highly and commend the excellent soundboard recording; the performance is rare and energetic, outweighing minor ambiguities about set classification.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very little hiss, crisp and clear mix; no reported drop‑outs or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts with an unplanned acoustic mini‑set due to Phil’s traffic delay, then transitions smoothly into the electric portion; the spontaneous moments add charm.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Humorous moment where he admits not knowing all the words to “Wake Up Little Susie”; overall strong guitar work noted implicitly by the show’s praise.
band_member_comments.Phil: Late / stuck in traffic, prompting the acoustic set; his bass presence is mentioned as part of the early acoustic experiment.
